boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten current OU student-friendly activities with documented complimentary admission or free public access.

cards.entity_name: Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 555 Elm Ave., OU campus
cards.notes: Bring a current OU ID and move through the galleries together; OU lists current students among visitors with no admission fee.
cards.short_summary: A campus art-museum visit that is complimentary with an OU ID.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s current visitor page states there are no admission fees for current OU students with university ID.
cards.source_title: Visit — Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday and Sunday during posted museum hours; present current OU ID for complimentary admission.

cards.entity_name: Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History
cards.title: Explore the Sam Noble Museum
cards.subtitle: 2401 Chautauqua Ave., OU campus
cards.notes: Meet at the permanent galleries and take photos where permitted; the museum’s visit information lists free admission for OU students.
cards.short_summary: Natural-history galleries available to OU students without admission cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sam Noble Museum’s current plan-your-visit page lists free admission for OU students.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Sam Noble Museum
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Tuesday–Saturday and Sunday as posted; bring OU identification for free student admission.

cards.entity_name: OU Baseball at L. Dale Mitchell Park
cards.title: Catch an OU baseball game
cards.subtitle: L. Dale Mitchell Park, OU campus
cards.notes: Check the home schedule, then bring your OU ID to the box office; regular-season student admission is free while tickets remain.
cards.short_summary: A regular-season baseball outing with free student entry, subject to availability.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to regular-season baseball games at L. Dale Mitchell Park while general-admission tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Show OU student ID at the L. Dale Mitchell Park box office on game day; entry is first-come, first-served while tickets are available.

cards.title: Watch OU softball at Love's Field
cards.subtitle: Love's Field, OU campus
cards.notes: Pick a home date and claim a standing-room ticket at the box office; current OU students enter free while that inventory lasts.
cards.short_summary: Free student access to home softball from the standing-room section.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to softball at Love’s Field while standing-room-only tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Claim a standing-room ticket at the Love’s Field box office on game day; availability is first-come, first-served.

cards.entity_name: OU Soccer at OU Soccer Field
cards.title: See an OU soccer match
cards.subtitle: OU Soccer Field, OU campus
cards.notes: Find a home match and show your OU ID at entry; OU Athletics lists free student admission while general-admission space is available.
cards.short_summary: A free student match-day option at the campus soccer field.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to soccer on a first-come, first-served basis while general-admission tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Show OU student ID; gates to OU Soccer Field open one hour before the match unless otherwise noted.

cards.entity_name: OU Volleyball at McCasland Field House
cards.title: Cheer at an OU volleyball match
cards.subtitle: McCasland Field House, OU campus
cards.notes: Coordinate around a home match, then bring your OU ID; students receive free entry while general-admission tickets are still available.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost student volleyball outing in McCasland Field House.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to volleyball on a first-come, first-served basis while general-admission tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Present OU student ID; McCasland Field House doors open one hour before the match unless otherwise noted.

cards.entity_name: OU Men's Gymnastics at McCasland Field House
cards.title: Watch OU men's gymnastics
cards.subtitle: McCasland Field House, OU campus
cards.notes: Use the home schedule to choose a meet and show your OU ID at the door; student admission is complimentary while space remains.
cards.short_summary: A free student seat for a collegiate gymnastics meet.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to men’s gymnastics on a first-come, first-served basis while general-admission tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Show OU student ID; McCasland Field House doors open one hour before the meet unless otherwise noted.

cards.entity_name: OU Wrestling at McCasland Field House
cards.title: Take in an OU wrestling dual
cards.subtitle: McCasland Field House, OU campus
cards.notes: Choose a home dual and arrive with your OU ID; OU Athletics provides free student admission while general-admission inventory remains.
cards.short_summary: A free student way to attend an OU wrestling event.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states students receive free admission to wrestling on a first-come, first-served basis while general-admission tickets are available.
cards.access_notes: Show OU student ID; McCasland Field House doors open one hour before the bout unless otherwise noted.

cards.title: Follow an OU tennis match
cards.subtitle: OU campus tennis venue
cards.notes: Check the official home schedule and watch from the spectator areas; regular-season home tennis events are free and need no ticket.
cards.short_summary: A public, ticket-free way to see OU tennis in regular season.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states regular-season home tennis events are free admission and do not require a ticket.
cards.access_notes: Applies to regular-season home tennis; OU notes hosted postseason events may have admission fees.

cards.title: Watch OU track and field
cards.subtitle: OU campus track-and-field venue
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to find a regular-season home meet and settle in together; OU lists those meets as free without tickets.
cards.short_summary: Regular-season track-and-field spectating without admission cost.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Athletics states regular-season home track-and-field events are free admission and do not require a ticket.
cards.access_notes: Applies to regular-season home track-and-field events; OU notes hosted postseason events may have admission fees.
